positions.name: AuthorityOverKestrelwoodRecord
positions.frame: who holds the authority to determine what the observatory's record says happened with the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration?
positions.why: All three expressions enact authority-ranking around the same contested record: the two imperatives (src-1, src-2) command erasure of knowledge about the spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's work, while src-3 supplies the flat counter-factual ('never calibrated it') that would justify the erasure. The directive force and the declarative fact-claim are in tension — one commands forgetting, the other asserts there was nothing to remember — but both are readable as moves to control who gets to say what the calibration record is, which is why they cohere under a single authority-over-the-record frame rather than as isolated commentary.
